brief_title: Co-administration Study in Patients With Elevated Cholesterol and Coronary Heart Disease (0653-802)(COMPLETED)
official_title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study to Evaluate Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of Ezetimibe 10 mg or Placebo Co-administered With Existing Simvastatin 10 mg or 20 mg in Attaining Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol Target Levels in Patients With Hypercholesterolemia and Coronary Heart Disease.

primary_outcomes.measure: Percentage of patients reaching their target LDL-C goal of </= 2.60 mmol/L, after 6 weeks of treatment

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate additional cholesterol lowering effects in patients with coronary heart disease by giving an investigational drug with a patient's current approved cholesterol lowering medication.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with elevated cholesterol and coronary heart disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have cholesterol levels within normal ranges as identified by the study

inclusion.text: Patients with elevated cholesterol and coronary heart disease

exclusion.text: Patients who have cholesterol levels within normal ranges as identified by the study
